_comment: Minimal Northwind CdcSinkConfiguration for the W3 Map step of the E2E test. Postgres lowercases unquoted identifiers; the fixture in test/SlowTests/Data/npgsql.northwind.create.sql declares Customer/Product unquoted so their stored names are 'customer' / 'product'. 'Order' is the only quoted table -- declared as "Order" so its stored name is 'Order' (capital O preserved). Columns inside "Order" are unquoted so lowercased to id/orderdate/customerid/totalamount. Validation requires every primary-key column to also appear in Columns.
Name: wizard-cdc
